items.title: Chevron Could Be Big Winner If Venezuela Pulls Out of OPEC
items.summary: Venezuela is edging away from OPEC, U.S. companies are circling its vast untapped oil fields, and one American energy giant already has a foot in the door before the bidding even begins.

items.title: ExxonMobil Stock's Biggest Risk Is The Shortage Ending
items.summary: ExxonMobil's refining and chemical margins rest on capacity that is offline elsewhere, which makes a return to normal supply the risk worth weighing.

items.title: Covered Call Yields with ConocoPhillips Are Attractive as COP Stock Is Near a Peak
items.summary: ConocoPhillips stock (COP) is just off a three-month peak. That makes selling COP covered calls with a one-month expiry attractive to shareholders. The $140 call expiring Sept. 25 yields 1.75%.
